rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Rundll32_Temp {
    meta:
        description = "Detects rundll32 loading payload from Temp directory, typical of Cobalt Strike"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-09"
    strings:
        $s1 = "rundll32.exe" fullword ascii
        $s2 = "\\Temp\\" fullword ascii
        $s3 = { 6A 40 68 [2-4] 00 00 6A 00 6A 00 6A 00 } // typical shellcode allocation pattern
    condition:
        $s1 and $s2 and $s3
}

        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacon patterns from internal hosts with high-risk indicators"

        reference = "INC-AP1-V2, ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Activity"

        $beacon_get and $beacon_post and $crypt_blob and
        ip.src in ["10.0.5.42"]
}
